item: A-036: the app, scheduler and custody settings read path lives once (SettingsStore)
summary: The four read functions (_use_kv, _read_json_file, _read_raw, _read_raw_strict) were byte-identical in three modules bar file name, kv key, error classes and log text; they now delegate to one SettingsStore with the same wrapper names, so tests that patch _settings_path or _use_kv are unchanged. safety/settings.py stays out (fails closed) and _write_raw stays duplicated (the three writes differ; custody's is not atomic). No behaviour change.
